item.title: New Jersey launches $5M plan for 2026 FIFA World Cup fan zones, festivals statewide
item.description: Gov. Mikie Sherrill announced a $5 million NJEDA-led initiative to fund fan zones, watch parties and festivals statewide ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup Final at MetLife Stadium.

item.title: Man who lived rent-free at New Yorker Hotel pleads guilty to fraud after claiming to own it
item.description: A man who lived at The New Yorker Hotel rent-free for five years pleaded guilty to fraud on Wednesday after falsely claiming to own the storied building.

item.title: Eric Dane, 'Grey's Anatomy' and 'Euphoria' star, dies at 53 after ALS battle
item.description: Eric Dane — best known for playing Dr. Mark Sloan, the charismatic "McSteamy," on Grey's Anatomy — has died at the age of 53 following a battle with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), also known as Lou Gehrig’s disease.
